subject: English
passage:
The following text is adapted from Jacqueline Woodson's 2014 novel Brown Girl Dreaming.

[Aunt Caroline] was as organized as my mother was scattered. Even when she was relaxing, she kept everything in order, folding magazines neatly and arranging cushions just so.

©2014 by Jacqueline Woodson
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence?

choices.A: It explains why Aunt Caroline prefers to spend time alone.
choices.B: It describes the narrator's relationship with both family members.
choices.C: It reveals the narrator's preference for Aunt Caroline's lifestyle.
choices.D: It contrasts Aunt Caroline with the narrator's mother.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer because it most accurately describes how the underlined sentence functions in the text as a whole. The underlined sentence establishes a difference between Aunt Caroline and the narrator's mother by describing Aunt Caroline as "organized" and the narrator's mother as "scattered." The text then elaborates on that contrast, describing some ways Aunt Caroline maintains order even when she isn't actively working.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the text doesn't indicate whether Aunt Caroline prefers to spend time alone, only that she is organized even when relaxing.
